test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The tiger killed a deer.

options.text: A deer had been killed by the tiger
A deer was killed by the tiger
A deer has been killed by the tiger.
The deer was killed by a tiger.

solution:
The correct answer is **"A deer was killed by the tiger."**
